name: Treacherous Cold

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know Dun Morogh's peaks as your homeland. Yet sudden avalanches and hostile elements can claim even seasoned mountaineers in the high passes.
As a hunter, you know mountaineers depend on their rifles in the frozen wilds. They carve their names into the stocks so their identities and deeds will be remembered.
As an Alliance member, you can help recover fallen mountaineers' gear. Then Ironforge can bring word to the families whose loved ones guard the high roads.

faq.answer: You search Dun Morogh's snow-choked passes for mountaineers caught in sudden slides and recover their service rifles.

aliases: why do we need their guns
faq.answer: Mountaineers engrave their names on their rifle stocks. If snow buries their bodies or makes them impossible to recover, their weapons can identify them so Ironforge can notify their families.
faq.q: Why are the mountaineers' rifles collected?

aliases: who gets lost in dun morogh
faq.answer: Novice mountaineers on patrol in Dun Morogh face particular danger from sudden avalanches, falling ice, and harsh weather in the high peaks.
faq.q: Who is being lost in the snow?

faq.answer: The scout who asks for help usually searches for survivors and gathers the fallen after a slide. Recent elemental disturbances in Dun Morogh have made the deep passes too dangerous to search alone.
faq.q: Why hasn't the search been conducted already?

faq.answer: The recovered rifles go back to Ironforge, where authorities make sure the fallen mountaineers' families receive their personal weapons.
faq.q: What happens to the rifles once recovered?

faq.answer: Dun Morogh's heights bring severe cold, blinding slides, and unstable cliffs. Restless elemental activity adds to the danger, and even trained dwarven patrols can quickly succumb.
faq.q: What makes the high passes of Dun Morogh so dangerous?

sections.body: In Dun Morogh, sudden avalanches and falling ice threaten travelers and soldiers. Even Ironforge's hardened mountaineers can be overwhelmed. When winter strikes without warning, novice recruits may pay with their lives.
sections.title: Perils of the Peaks

sections.body: Mountain slides can bury patrols, and each search through the hazardous terrain races against time. Elemental activity across the region has grown more intense, making rescue parties perilous to send out. Scouts ask you to search the drifts for fallen mountaineers and recover their inscribed rifles before snow hides them forever.
sections.title: Grim Recovery

sections.body: Ironforge mountaineers carve their names into their rifle stocks. Recovering those weapons from the drifts helps identify the fallen, so their families in Ironforge can learn of their service.
sections.title: Inscribed Stocks

summary: In Dun Morogh, snow and ice slides bury Ironforge mountaineers in the high passes. You search for their inscribed rifles so their families can learn who fell.
